description: Open a URL on an emulated phone and map its user journeys: each screen gets a report (type, UI patterns, ranked next taps, QA findings) and an image. Go on with jevway_journey_step (you pick) or jevway_journey_autopilot (Jev explores), describe screens with jevway_journey_annotate, end with jevway_journey_finish.

intent.description: One journey to follow; omit to explore.

stay_within.description: URL prefix to stay under (default: same origin).

name: jevway_journey_start
title: Start mapping mobile user journeys
